title: Historical topic-first research generator contract
objective: Generate explainable palindrome candidates from historically attested factors while preserving provenance, uncertainty, and gate traces.

supported_operations.description: Keep host A/B/C/D fixed and substitute E3 from another source sharing the same morphologically valid D.
requirements: host and donor are in the fixed research corpus
D reading matches and D morphology is valid for the operation
supported_operations.rationale: E3 sits at the 31-kana center and is self-reversing, so the operation does not move outer A/B/C/D boundaries.

supported_operations.description: Vary only explicitly attested options inside a curated scene family such as v0.46.
requirements: each variable factor has attested neighboring connections
morphologically sensitive corridor is fixed or explicitly signed
all outputs remain research candidates pending review

supported_operations.reason_disabled: Current research shows broad-field and local-factor validity are insufficient without scene and semantic-role constraints.

required_input.topic: broad research topic such as 秋・月 or 信仰
required_input.scene: narrower scene or null; null forces review-needed rather than broad-field auto-pass

candidate_schema.attestation_trace: which local factors/phrases are historically attested
candidate_schema.morphology_trace: which seams are moved, fixed, signed, source-specific, or unresolved
candidate_schema.scene_trace: broad field, narrow scene evidence, pass/hold/review
candidate_schema.semantic_role_trace: host role, donor role, compatibility outcome
candidate_schema.review_status: deep-review / hold-* / research-reviewed; never implicit accepted

gate_order.rule: Reading must be exactly 31 kana under the declared normalization and strictly equal to its reverse for the current strict research mode.
Changed local factor connection must be historically attested or explicitly reviewed; unchanged host context is not reclassified as a transfer.
Evaluate morphology primarily for boundaries actually moved or reused across sources. Preserve source-specific signatures separately from global signatures.
Broad topic is not enough. Require narrow scene compatibility or explicit review.
Imported factor must preserve the host phrase's discourse/semantic job; missing role metadata becomes review-needed.
Do not upgrade mining/transcription evidence to source-image-confirmed.
Review syntax, viewpoint, time, subject, lexical plausibility and forcedness. Machine gates never auto-certify natural classical Japanese.

implementation_sequence: Emit gate traces even for held candidates.
Compare generated candidate universe against v0.57 fixture.
Only then add curated scene-microgrammar enumeration.
Do not wire research generator into public UI until candidate review quality is separately accepted.
non_goals: publishing wave2 held readings as verified
